preconditions.description: The length of the input string s is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.split()[0])
preconditions.description: The input string s consists only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The length of the omeric string is equal to the length of the input string s.
The omeric string is the concatenation of the longest palindromic suffix and the longest palindromic prefix of the input string s.
The output contains the omeric string followed by a line with the frequency of each prefix.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(freq), int) and int(freq) > 0 for freq in stdout.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each frequency in the output is a positive integer.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[0].startswith(prefix) for prefix in [stdout.split()[0][:i] for i in range(1, len(stdout.split()[0]) + 1)])
postconditions.description: Each prefix in the output is a valid prefix of the omeric string.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.split()[0].count(prefix) == int(stdout.split()[i]) for i, prefix in enumerate([stdout.split()[0][:i] for i in range(1, len(stdout.split()[0]) + 1)], 1))
postconditions.description: Each frequency corresponds to the number of times the respective prefix appears as a substring in the omeric string.
